purpose: Test whether same-refold-qualified completions from the full-context RePaint teacher are useful endpoint labels for an isolated-fragment student.
qualification_result: 13 strict successes in 9 families, 57 designable of 128; parent 8 in 7 families, 45 designable. Paired strict contrast 0.0390625, family bootstrap CI [-0.0078125,0.09375]. This licenses a capacity pilot, not an improvement claim.
labels: All 13 teacher outputs passing raw validity/motif and same-valid-refold motif/global/scaffold criteria, with no ranking among them. Use their saved complete generated latent endpoints. Matched native arm has the identical 13 slots/protein multiplicities but substitutes each protein's original native reference latent. No mixture with failed teacher outputs; all failures remain in source reports.
conditioning: Both arms receive only the unchanged isolated 20-residue fragment latent, supplied motif sequence, relative fragment geometry, chain length and insertion position. Native-context motif codes, full sequence, teacher scaffold, confidence, successful design sequence and success labels never enter conditioning. Full generated latents are supervised targets only.
training: Reuse the frozen-parent/adapter-only positive reference-field regression recipe from native_positive_training_protocol.json, with beta0.5 and no negative endpoint. Within each length bucket draw label slots uniformly with replacement using the same primary RNG in both arms. Same initialization, optimizer, batches, random times/noise and reference self-conditioning; only positive endpoints differ. Explicitly audit matched IDs and noise/time/history draws and target hashes. No additional training on teacher initial sampling noise.
lr_schedule: Cosine to 0.1 floor over 400 updates; the profiles execute the identical first 40 steps.
data_audit: Recompute complete 13-slot membership from the four audited partitions; bind comparison, refold, generation and latent array hashes. Verify source same-refold success and exact isolated features against original fragment corpus. Record four pairs of distinct strict teacher completions across four families, mean scaffold TM0.283175; diversity is not interchangeable with coverage.
profile: Two matched 40-update single-RTX profiles. Reproduce parent predictions at initialization on one predeclared training control per length bucket; preserve frozen generator/reference adapter, null predictions, isolated-fragment rigid-pose invariance and all numerical controls. Reload saved EMA. A qualified profile determines 400-update allocations; profile raw scores do not select hypotheses or checkpoints.
evaluation: Fixed final 400-update endpoint only. All32 original training-diagnostic proteins, four original noise draws, original50Euler/AE3 learned-null settings. Report all128 conditioned samples per arm, validity, motif retention, families, and split the9 label families from23 other training families. Native/parent budgets reused without pooling; no locked tests. Refold each arm only if raw>=9 and valid>=45, the logical upper bounds for beating the parent. All128 outputs of an eligible arm get eight fixed-motif CA-onlyMPNN designs and deterministicFP32 ESMFold2-Fast3loops50steps. A numerically qualified omission of unused confidence outputs is allowed with a bound execution report. The same valid refold must meet the unchanged motif/global/scaffold criteria.
decision: Expand only if repaint-positive exceeds both parent and matched-native strict successes, retains at least7 successful families, and has at least45 designable outputs with no loss versus matched-native. Report paired family bootstrap intervals, outcome overlaps and diversity among strict successes, including failures. Passing licenses a separately specified fresh-noise/fragment-placement replication before broader training. Failure closes this 400-update recipe; no checkpoint/step/threshold sweep.
scope: Small selected-label capacity pilot on previously examined training proteins. No generalization claim; no claim that oracle context is available at deployment. Older cached ESMFold multistate augmentation and native-positive replay failures remain unchanged.
resources: At most8 own running-plus-pending GPUs; one RTX per profile or training job, measured runtime and memory before scaling. Only registered jobs, explicit completion audits, frozen code/configurations and no data in Git.
